sentence: A shared task board for an event where each person can take an open task, mark their own done, drop it, or add a new task.
use_when: Sharing out chores and supplies for a party or gathering
Everyone needs to see who is bringing or doing what
A group wants to claim tasks and tick them off before an event
Someone needs to add a missed item to the list
dont_use_when: Splitting a bill or tracking who owes money
Picking a date, time or option by vote
Assigning tasks by a host with no self-claiming, or tracking long-running projects with deadlines
